## Big idea

Sometimes you must read the body twice, add headers, or change the response.  
Raw request/response streams can be read only once — use wrappers.

```text
Filter wraps request/response
        │
        ▼
Downstream code reads the wrapper (safe)
```

## Common uses

- Add security headers
- Capture response body for logging
- Normalize incoming JSON
- Block requests missing a header

## Practice ideas

1. Filter that rejects requests without header `X-Request-Id` (return 400).
2. Filter that adds `X-Response-Time` header after `chain.doFilter`.
3. Log status code from `HttpServletResponse`.

## Reasoning

Mutating bodies is powerful and easy to break. Prefer small, tested filters. For auth, prefer Spring Security filters when you reach those lectures.
